description: Extend the validation dashboard for three instruments (MCL, MNQ, MES). Add MES row with WFE-gated pending status. Add portfolio P&L chart. Add correlation exposure indicator to command center. All changes must pass pnpm build.

userStories.title: Audit current validation page structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to understand the current validation/page.tsx structure before modifying it (it's 1,603 lines).
acceptanceCriteria: Read dashboard/app/validation/page.tsx
Identify: where instrument rows are defined, how WFE data is fetched, what API endpoints it calls
Read dashboard/lib/api.ts to find relevant fetch functions
Document in progress.txt: component structure, data flow, badge variants in use
No code changes — analysis only
Verify: badge variants used must be from strict set: 'bull' | 'bear' | 'warn' | 'info' | 'neutral'
userStories.notes: DO NOT add new badge variants. Only use: bull, bear, warn, info, neutral

userStories.title: Add MES row to validation scorecard
userStories.description: As a trader, I want to see MES in the validation scorecard with its current WFE status and a clear indicator that it is pending re-validation.
acceptanceCriteria: MES row added to instrument scorecard table
MES status shows: WFE=0.09, Status='Revalidating', badge variant='warn'
Row includes fields: Symbol, Timeframe, WFE, PF, Sharpe, WR, Status
When MES achieves WFE≥0.40 (future), row transitions to 'APPROVED' with badge='bull'
Row fetches MES data from the same API endpoint as MCL/MNQ (or shows static data if endpoint not yet available)
cd dashboard && pnpm run build — passes
cd dashboard && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit — 0 errors
Commit: feat: add MES row to validation scorecard with revalidating status
userStories.notes: Use 'use client' only if needed for interactivity. Default to Server Component.

userStories.title: Add portfolio-level P&L chart
userStories.description: As a trader, I want a combined portfolio P&L chart that shows cumulative performance across all active instruments.
acceptanceCriteria: Add portfolio P&L chart to validation page or command-center page (whichever is more appropriate based on audit)
Chart shows cumulative P&L by instrument (MCL, MNQ) as separate lines plus combined total
Placeholder MES line shown as dashed/inactive until WFE gate passes
Chart uses recharts (already in project)
Data fetched from GET /paper/performance or existing performance endpoint
If no combined endpoint exists, fetch per-instrument and combine on client
cd dashboard && pnpm run build — passes
Commit: feat: add portfolio P&L chart with per-instrument breakdown
userStories.notes: Check what performance endpoints exist: grep -r 'performance' engine/routers/ --include='*.py' -l

userStories.title: Add correlation exposure indicator to command center
userStories.description: As a trader, I want to see current portfolio correlation exposure on the command center so I know when the MNQ+MES size reduction rule is active.
acceptanceCriteria: Read dashboard/app/command-center/page.tsx to understand current layout (it's 1,286 lines)
Add a 'Portfolio Correlation' indicator widget
Widget shows: instrument pairs, correlation values, whether reduction is active
Fetches from GET /portfolio/risk (added by Agent 3)
If Agent 3's endpoint not yet available: add UI with loading/unavailable state gracefully
Widget uses badge variant 'warn' when correlation reduction is active, 'neutral' otherwise
cd dashboard && pnpm run build — passes
Commit: feat: add portfolio correlation exposure widget to command center
userStories.notes: The /portfolio/risk endpoint is being built by Agent 3 concurrently. Use SWR with a fallback state if endpoint returns 404.

userStories.title: Add MES re-validation progress tracker
userStories.description: As a trader, I want to see MES experiment progress on the dashboard — how many of 50 parameter combinations have been tested and what the best WFE so far is.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a 'MES Re-Validation' progress section to validation page
Shows: experiments run (e.g. 25/50), best WFE found so far, gate target (WFE≥0.40)
Progress bar showing experiment completion
Data read from GET /experiments/mes/status (check if endpoint exists from RL work, else add it)
If endpoint not yet available: shows static 'Campaign in progress' state
cd dashboard && pnpm run build — passes
